entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your well-timed ranged attacks protect your allies as they advance on the battlefield.

Prerequisite(s): Far Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, keen senses racial trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you damage a target using a ranged attack, that target can’t make attacks of opportunity for 1 round against your allies who also have this feat when they move out of one of the target’s threatened squares.
